title: Stage B One-Next-Command Natural-Route Search Preregistration

pilotActivation.reason: This source-only pass preregisters one Worms-owned L4+ question and accepts no witness, cross-world return, placement, promotion, ProductAuthority or P5 claim.

sourceBindings.byteDefinition: Git blob bytes at the bound commit; checkout line-ending transformations are not source bytes.

aliasObservationCut.sourceLabelCaveat: The source label and the word visible do not establish actual HUD or player visibility; D2P expressly keeps this authority-side cut distinct from the player's HUD.

cutDefinition.projectionDescription: Retain only active actor, unit positions, and visible Stitching as a deliberately destructive control.

constraints: One declared V4 move command is applied to each supplied full authority state.

protectedFamily: Only the tempting visible duel readout is compared.
Any future split hidden by this readout must remain explicit aliasing residue.
intentionallyForgottenDistinctions: Movement budget, turn and revision counters, selected Relic, aim, alive flags, facing, phase, terrain, RNG state, projectile state, and terminal result.
excludedClaims: This cut is intentionally incomplete and cannot establish deterministic continuation.
Matching visible duel readouts do not establish equal authority state, recurrence, or return.

projectionSemantics.activeActorMeaning: authority state activeActor, not the submitted command actor
projectionSemantics.unitOrder: preserve source state.units array order; do not sort by id
projectionSemantics.objectKeys: deep-sort by UTF-16 code-unit comparison before canonical serialization
projectionSemantics.classEquality: exact equality of cutId, cutVersion and the retained projected value; class-key equality is checked against retained values

immutableD2QAnchorChart.stageBUse: immutable structural anchor and source lineage only
immutableD2QAnchorChart.forbiddenUse: D2Q cases, outputs or verdicts must not form Stage B source equivalence classes, count as new evidence or enter the Stage B selection key

fixedFrame.cut: thin_visible_duel_v0@2 source equality versus one-next-command authority readout
fixedFrame.domain: The complete finite attempted-word domain and its naturally reachable accepted-prefix subset defined by routeDomain below.
fixedFrame.routes: Movement-only legal prefix words generated in registered shortlex order; no injected state and no empty-prefix source item.
fixedFrame.horizon: Exactly one applySimulationCommand call after each eligible endpoint; zero tick, network, UI, browser, device or playtest steps.
fixedFrame.support: Bound V4 source, fresh deterministic initialization, accepted and mutated legal prefixes, exact actor/turn derivation, immutable input, and complete route/pair retention.
fixedFrame.tolerance: Exact canonical equality with numeric tolerance 0 and no fuzzy, semantic, locale or timestamp comparison.
fixedFrame.oracleInputBoundary: Authority state may establish reachability, source class and protected readout. Calibration labels, D2Q case IDs, expected outcomes, reviewer knowledge and selected-pair labels may not enter generation, classing, decoding or outcome choice.

routeDomain.wordOrder: shortlex: depth 2, then 4, then 8; lexicographic within a depth using -1 before +1
generator: Construct the exact 276 direction words in registered shortlex order without consulting outcomes.
If a word extends a prefix already retained in the rejected-prefix ledger, retain a pruned_by_rejected_prefix row and perform no simulation for that word.
Otherwise initialize a fresh V4 state for that word and replay its directions from the first element.
At each prefix step derive actor from current state.activeActor and expectedTurn from current state.turn, then call applySimulationCommand(current, actor, {type:'move',direction}, expectedTurn).

Require accepted true, mutated true, absent error and the registered current actor/turn rule. On first ordinary command rejection, retain the exact rejected prefix and transition, stop that word and prune all extensions.
An accepted transition that violates the registered mutation, actor/turn, source, invariant or input-immutability rule is a frame_support_failure, not an ordinary rejected-prefix row.
An endpoint is naturally reachable only when every route prefix passed. The empty prefix and nonregistered depths never become source items.
Before source projection or next-command decoding, remove each exact calibration occurrence listed in holdoutExclusion from source-item eligibility.
Project every remaining endpoint with thin_visible_duel_v0@2 and retain both exact projected value and class key.
Group endpoints by exact projected value, then form every unordered pair of distinct route occurrences within each class in canonical ascending routeId order.
Decode every eligible endpoint once with the fixed next command, compare every eligible pair, and exhaust the entire domain even after a positive split.

holdoutExclusion.exclusionSemantics: Exclude each occurrence individually. Neither may become a source item, receive the registered next-command readout, occur in an eligible pair, count as a witness or be run separately as a sentinel. Traversing the two-step word only as an internal prefix of another longer registered word is permitted.
holdoutExclusion.emptyPrefixD2QExclusion: The fresh initialization and all D2Q cases are not Stage B source items.
holdoutExclusion.stateEquivalenceResidue: The committed calibration artifacts publish route words and historical readouts but no endpoint-state digests. Excluding every state-equivalent occurrence would require the forbidden replay, so exact route-occurrence exclusion is the strongest current source-bound holdout.
holdoutExclusion.evidenceIndependence: All remaining routes reuse the same bound source, cut domain and seed and are correlated_reuse, never empirically independent.

tolerance.hashRole: identify exact retained bytes; hashes never substitute for decoded equality

definitions.frame_support_failure: A bound source, world, cut, domain, legality, completeness, actor/turn, fixed support, input immutability, decoder, tolerance, holdout, oracle or output-retention condition fails. Ordinary rejected route prefixes are not frame failures.
definitions.command_semantic_split: The frame passes and the exact command-semantic tuples differ.
definitions.continuation_support_split: The frame and command-semantic tuple pass equally, but post-command movementRemaining differs.
definitions.provenance_exact_state_only_split: The frame, command semantics and continuation-support coordinate agree, but a registered revision, canonical state digest or exact route-provenance coordinate differs.
definitions.no_target_relevant_split: The frame passes and command semantics plus continuation support agree; route distinction alone does not elevate the outcome.

outcomeContract.carrierGuard: Revision inequality, pre/post state-digest inequality, route inequality or their combination alone never certifies a continuation-bearing carrier, licenses Tau or sets targetRelevant true. A target-relevant split only creates a candidate result for later review.

stoppingAndRetention.normalStoppingRule: Exhaust the complete registered attempted-word domain, every eligible source class and every eligible pair; never stop at the first positive.
stoppingAndRetention.failClosedRule: On source, frame, decoder, completeness or retention drift, stop execution, retain all partial records and classify the package invalid with frame_support_failure; do not salvage a positive pair.
negativeResultsRetained: no eligible alias class after the exact holdout
eligible alias classes exist but every pair has no_target_relevant_split
every command-semantic and continuation-support comparison with exact equality
all frame/support failures and partial results
stoppingAndRetention.reopeningRule: Any changed source byte, seed, calling, cut, projection, route alphabet/order/depth, reachability rule, holdout, next command, horizon, decoder, tolerance, oracle boundary, outcome rule, retention rule or output path requires a new preregistration version before execution.

plannedWitnessContract.O_W: thin_visible_duel_v0@2 exact projected value and source class plus the exact one-next-command decoder record
plannedWitnessContract.B_W: fresh V4 initialization and only accepted, mutated MOVE prefixes from the complete registered finite attempted-word domain
plannedWitnessContract.S_W: bound authority/cut bytes, legal route provenance, exact actor/turn derivation, endpoint support, decoder provenance and immutable input
plannedWitnessContract.plannedOmega_W: the registered world, cut, target, domain, routes, horizon, support, zero tolerance and oracle/input boundary

desiredProtectedFamily: post-command movementRemaining as declared continuation support
recoverable exact route and state provenance without promoting provenance-only differences
anticipatedResidue: state-equivalent calibration-neighborhood exclusion is unavailable without forbidden replay
aim/fire, projectile, tick, network, UI, browser/device and playtest behavior

selectedTransition.licenseCondition: Only a later separately reviewed result may determine whether the D2Q protected readout and new continuation record remain decodable/re-enterable across the move while residue and provenance remain recoverable.

evidenceCovariance.reason: Stage B reuses the bound V4 authority, thin-cut source, sole admitted seed and calibration lineage. New deterministic route records may improve discrimination and recoverability but do not become empirically independent merely because they are newly executed.

futureExecutionPass.requiredStartingSource: durable committed Stage B v1 preregistration source plus its reviewed terminal evidence

validationContract.strictJson: reject duplicate keys, duplicate IDs, duplicate source rows, duplicate output rows and duplicate holdout occurrences
validationContract.parity: compare package/support/child IDs, source and terminal commits, cut and projection, route domain/generator, holdout, next command, actor/turn, horizon, decoder, tolerance, fixed/varying coordinates, outcomes, witness states, Tau status, evidence class, output lists, authorization and stop across machine registration, human contract and work evidence
validationContract.sourceAudit: recompute each bound commit/path/mode/blob/Git-byte SHA-256 and the embedded cut-definition canonical digest
validationContract.preservationAudit: require every Stage A and listed D2P/D2Q artifact at the preregistration terminal to retain the exact bound mode and blob
validationContract.rangeAudit: bind every raw changed-path/status/mode/blob row from Stage A terminal through source and terminal commits; reject renames, deletes, nonregular modes and undeclared paths at endpoints and intermediate commits

firstGovernedStop.condition: The three source-only preregistration artifacts are committed, exact audits pass, identified read-only review is recorded, and the evidence carrier is closed without execution.
firstGovernedStop.stopStatement: WP-015D2R Stage B preregistration stopped; Stage B execution not opened.
